declarations.name: toNumber
declarations.description: Reads a number, or a numeric string such as `"1234.5"` or `"-1e6"`; anything else (blank, `"abc"`, `NaN`) is `undefined`.

declarations.name: scaleBytes
declarations.description: Scales a byte (or bit) count to the largest unit that keeps it at or above 1: `1536` is `1.5` `kilobyte`.

declarations.name: numberFormatOptions
declarations.description: The `Intl.NumberFormatOptions` that `options` describe, with `value` already scaled for `bytes`.

declarations.name: formatNumber
declarations.description:
Formats `value` with `Intl.NumberFormat`: grouping and decimals of the locale, currency, percent, units, compact
notation, and byte sizes scaled to the largest unit that fits. An option the browser rejects (an unknown currency
code or unit) falls back to a plain decimal rather than throwing.

declarations.name: formatNumberToParts
declarations.description: formatNumber, split into the parts `Intl.NumberFormat#formatToParts` names: `integer`, `currency`, `unit`, `compact`…

A number formatted for its reader: grouping and decimals of the locale, an amount of money, a percentage, a measure,
a compact count ("1.2K") or a byte size ("1.5 MB"). The text comes from `Intl.NumberFormat` in the element's
`locale` (else the nearest `lang` attribute, which it follows as soon as it changes, else the browser's language), so
the same markup reads "1,234.5" in English and "1 234,5" in French.

`value` takes a number, or a numeric string in markup. Until it holds a valid number the element shows its default
slot, for a fallback such as "—". The digits sit in a `<data>` element whose `value` is the raw number; a shortened
display (compact notation, a byte size) carries the full figure as its hover title. The currency symbol, unit,
percent sign and compact suffix are wrapped in `part="unit"`, so they can be set smaller or lighter than the digits,
and a negative or positive value takes its own colour, for profit and loss.
declarations.name: FormatNumber

members.name: value
members.description: The number to format: a number from script, or a numeric string such as `1234.5` in markup.

members.name: type
members.description: `decimal`, `currency` (with `currency`), `percent` (0.25 reads "25%"), `unit` (with `unit`) or `bytes` (1536 reads "1.5 kB").

members.name: notation
members.description: `standard`, `compact` ("1.2K"), `scientific` ("1.2E3") or `engineering`.

members.name: compactDisplay
members.description: Length of the compact suffix: `short` ("1.2K") or `long` ("1.2 thousand").

members.name: currency
members.description: ISO 4217 currency code for `type="currency"`, such as `EUR` or `JPY`; its own decimals are used.

members.name: currencyDisplay
members.description: How the currency is named: `symbol` ("$"), `narrowSymbol`, `code` ("USD") or `name` ("US dollars").

members.name: currencySign
members.description: `accounting` writes a negative amount in parentheses where the locale does.

members.name: unit
members.description: For `type="unit"`, a unit `Intl.NumberFormat` knows (`kilometer-per-hour`, `celsius`, `liter`); for `type="bytes"`, `byte` (default) or `bit`.

members.name: unitDisplay
members.description: How the unit is named: `short` ("5 km/h"), `narrow` ("5km/h") or `long` ("5 kilometers per hour").

members.name: signDisplay
members.description: When to show the sign: `auto`, `always`, `exceptZero` (a "+" on gains, none on zero), `negative` or `never`.

members.name: noGrouping
members.description: Drop the thousands separators, for years, IDs and codes.

members.name: binary
members.description: For `type="bytes"`, steps of 1024 instead of 1000, still labelled kB, MB… as Windows does.

members.name: minimumIntegerDigits
members.description: Pad the integer part with leading zeros to this many digits (1–21).

members.name: minimumFractionDigits
members.description: Fewest decimals to show (0–100); pads with zeros.

members.name: maximumFractionDigits
members.description: Most decimals to show (0–100); rounds the rest.

members.name: minimumSignificantDigits
members.description: Fewest significant digits (1–21); takes precedence over the fraction digits.

members.name: maximumSignificantDigits
members.description: Most significant digits (1–21); takes precedence over the fraction digits.

members.name: locale
members.description: BCP 47 locale of the number. Empty uses the nearest `lang` attribute, then the browser's language.

members.name: #language
members.description: `locale`, else the nearest `lang`, else the browser's language; a `lang` change redraws the number at once.
